integrity.audit_scope: Only a nonindependent, self-review is recorded; no independent validation is implied.
integrity.proof_basis: Exact spectral-projector identities and full necessity tests over graph families, not finite computational evidence.
integrity.reproducibility: Standalone standard-library exact rational verifier included as artifacts/verify.py.

scientific_limitations.excluded: No extension claimed to arbitrary weighted, directed, normalized, or general graph Laplacians, to internal Runge–Kutta stages, nonlinear problems, floating-point positivity, or stiff accuracy.
scientific_limitations.originality_uncertainty: An older graph-matrix-function theorem could express the same scalar criterion without matching terminology; bibliographic comparison cannot prove global priority.
scientific_limitations.scope: Finite, unweighted, connected complete multipartite undirected combinatorial graph Laplacians; all positive step scales and all continuous real scalar functions normalized at zero.

title: An exact positivity criterion on complete multipartite diffusion graphs
